Neuromuscular Monitoring Course
courses.short_description: This Neuromuscular Monitoring Course will be presented to you as an e-learning module with 4 content sections. You will learn more about Residual Neuromuscular Blockade, Types of Monitoring and Stimulation Patterns, Clinical Practice and Troubleshooting, and Reversal of Neuromuscular Blockade. This Course is part of a research project at Stanford to improve the use of Neuromuscular Monitoring and reduce the incidence of residual neuromuscular blockade.
